cause: R1364 admitted EVEX raw scans still enter decodeScanResultGeneric, initialize MCInst, populate it, and copy four fields into X86ScanResult. The intermediate representation has no consumer on these accepted paths.
change: Use the existing canonical projection to return packed ID and byte length directly from decodeScanResultFallback, before generic MCInst construction.
invariants: Keep shared canonical table and prefix/extract admission unchanged.
The existing adapter callback remains first; an installed adapter prevents the new projection even when it declines.
Only exact 64-bit mode uses the projection.
A zero result enters the original feature/generic reader exactly once; malformed or prefixed input is not accepted by the projection.
Preserve inactive target object identity and all public/private result bytes, cursor, error and guard-page behavior.
risk: The earlier placement changes fallback code and adds a predicate on extension misses. Native PE32, scalar, VEX and other architecture controls are required even if accepted EVEX work is reduced.
protocol: Four compiler semantic checks and original-consumer instruction counts first, then native timing, alternate profiles and actual product validation if warranted.
runtime_scope: Same ELF x86-64 GNU full-userspace gate as R1364.
